```yaml
name: Check AI Co-Authors

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-co-authors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install shellcheck-py yamllint actionlint

    - name: Run shellcheck
      run: shellcheck .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh

    - name: Run yamllint
      run: yamllint .github/workflows/check-ai-co-authors.yml

    - name: Run actionlint
      run: actionlint .github/workflows/check-ai-co-authors.yml

    - name: Check for AI co-authors
      id: check_co_authors
      run: .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh

    - name: Fail if AI co-authors found
      if: ${{ steps.check_co_authors.outputs.has_ai_authors == 'true' }}
      run: echo "::error::Error: AI co-authors detected. Please remove them from the commit message."
      error-action: stop
```
